```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories AS i
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(i2.version)
        FROM inventories AS i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
),
children AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT ci.id AS inventory_id, 1::BIGINT AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventories AS ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '80033-1'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ci.id, e.multiplier * c.quantity
    FROM exploded AS e
    JOIN children AS c
      ON c.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories AS ci
      ON ci.set_num = c.item_num
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.multiplier * ip.quantity), 0) AS total_units
FROM exploded AS e
JOIN inventory_parts AS ip
  ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '15504'
  AND NOT ip.is_spare;
```

```sql
    SELECT id, version, set_num
    FROM inventories
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) = 1
),
nested_items AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs
),
exploded(inventory_id, quantity) AS (
    SELECT ci.id, CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
    FROM current_inventory ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '41067-1'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ci.id, e.quantity * n.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN nested_items n ON n.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = n.item_num
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.quantity * ip.quantity), 0) AS total_units
FROM exploded e
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '15573'
  AND NOT ip.is_spare;
```
